transmission: 感染哺乳动物的唾液经咬伤、抓伤或黏膜暴露传播。
Infected mammal saliva through bites, scratches or mucosal exposure.
risk: 出现临床症状后几乎总是致命。
Almost invariably fatal once clinical symptoms appear.
prevention: 犬免疫；暴露后立即清洗伤口并就医评估疫苗及被动免疫。
Dog vaccination; immediate wound washing and medical assessment for post-exposure vaccination and passive immunization.

Direct contact with infectious body fluids or contaminated materials.

Infected animals, contaminated food and close person-to-person contact.

Encephalitis, severe lung disease and neurological sequelae.

Food protection, avoiding sick animals and healthcare precautions.

Infection can affect the brain, lungs and other organs.
progress: WHO将其列为研发优先疾病，候选产品在不同开发阶段。
A WHO R&D priority; candidate products are at different development stages.
future: 建议（编辑综合）：验证候选产品、强化早诊与幸存者神经康复。

Close skin or mucosal contact, contaminated materials and vertical transmission.

Mainly exposure to rodent excreta; Andes virus can spread between people.

Pulmonary syndrome or haemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome, with possible shock and death.

future: 建议（编辑综合）：更早识别重症，验证治疗方案与长期康复结局。
